items.question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN ym.Consumption END), 0) -
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN ym.Consumption END), 0) AS Difference
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212';

B1.sql:
WITH customer_total_2012 AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01' AND Date < '2013-01-01'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ct.total_consumption), 0)
   FROM customer_total_2012 ct
   JOIN customers c ON ct.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK')
  -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ct.total_consumption), 0)
   FROM customer_total_2012 ct
   JOIN customers c ON ct.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR')
AS consumption_difference;

JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212';

items.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH customer_total AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_total_per_segment AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM customer_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT
        ct.Segment,
        ct.total_consumption
    FROM customer_total ct
    JOIN min_total_per_segment m ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_total
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)

    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) -

items.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH segment_year AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, year
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption END) AS cons_2012,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) AS cons_2013
    FROM segment_year
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment,
       cons_2012,
       cons_2013,
       (cons_2013 - cons_2012) / cons_2013 * 100 AS percentage_increase
FROM pivot
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC;

    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1984'
    AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) < 50
    AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
ORDER BY p.ID;

    p.SEX,

items.question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
ORDER BY age_at_present DESC
LIMIT 200;

B1.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM Player_Attributes
),
eligible_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST(
        (strftime('%Y', ld.max_date) - strftime('%Y', p.birthday)) 
        - (strftime('%m-%d', ld.max_date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.birthday))
    AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM eligible_players ep
JOIN Player p ON ep.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
ORDER BY p.player_name;

    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.id IN (6, 23)
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN player_id = 6 THEN jumping END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN player_id = 23 THEN jumping END) AS jumping_difference
FROM latest_jumping
WHERE rn = 1;

  FROM frpm
  GROUP BY CDSCode
)

items.question: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?
items.author: team

B2.sql:
-- Find account numbers of clients who are youngest (maximum birthdate) and
-- belong to a district with the highest average salary (maximum A11).
-- Assumes client table exists with columns client_id and birth_date.
WITH
  max_birth AS (
    SELECT MAX(birth_date) AS max_birth_date FROM client
  ),
  max_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_avg_salary FROM district
  )
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id
CROSS JOIN max_birth mb
CROSS JOIN max_salary ms
WHERE c.birth_date = mb.max_birth_date
  AND ds.A11 = ms.max_avg_salary
ORDER BY a.account_id;
